definitions.adverse_drift: max(0, max_t(ask_t - ask_0)) over follow-up polls with ts_dec < ts <= ts_dec + W
definitions.decision_points: only hour boundaries H with a poll strictly before H on the tape (a fragment starting after :00 cannot say which poll was first)
definitions.decision_poll: first MARKET_DATA row with ts >= H (top of UTC hour), lag <= max_decision_lag
definitions.next_poll_adverse: max(0, ask_next - ask_0) to the first follow-up poll carrying the quote within max(windows); at the tape's ~40 s per-market cadence this is an UPPER bound on the 20 s drift
definitions.recommendation: adverse_fill = max(0.01, ceil_to_cent(max(p90 adverse drift at the primary window, p90 next-poll adverse drift)))
definitions.signed_next: ask_next - ask_0 for the first follow-up poll carrying the quote
